title: Measuring and Reducing Unusable Replies of LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.19659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: People delegate multi-step work to LLM agents and read only the reply that the agent hands back. Current evaluation scores task completion and the faithfulness of reports, and it leaves open whether the requester can understand and use the reply. We call this property reply usability and measure it with a reader model that takes the requester's position and tests whether the reply can be interpreted from what the requester has seen, is in the requester's language and answers the request. Its agreement with the majority of five annotators lies within the range of the individual annotators. Across eight models from seven families, 54% of 480 replies fail, and the best model still fails on 30%. Failed replies mostly point to material the requester has not seen or use labels that the agent coined during its work. translated_title: 测量并减少大语言模型智能体的不可用回复
translated_abstract: 人们将多步骤工作委托给大语言模型（LLM）智能体，并且通常只阅读智能体最终返回的回复。当前的评估方法关注任务完成度和报告的忠实性，却没有考虑请求者能否理解并使用这些回复。我们将这一属性称为“回复可用性”，并通过一个“读者模型”来测量它：该模型站在请求者的立场，检验回复能否仅根据请求者所见的信息被理解、是否使用请求者的语言、以及是否回答了请求。该测量方法与五位标注者的多数意见的一致程度处于单个标注者之间一致性的范围内。在对来自七个模型系列的八个模型的评估中，480个回复中有54%不合格，即使表现最好的模型也有30%不合格。不合格的回复大多指向请求者未曾见过的材料，或使用了智能体在工作过程中自创的标签。明确陈述对回复的要求可以将不合格率从0.52降至0.43，同时还能减少错误和遗漏。
tldr: 本文提出“回复可用性”概念并设计了基于读者模型的自动测量方法，发现LLM智能体超过一半的回复对请求者不可用，并通过让智能体明确陈述回复要求将不合格率从0.52降至0.43。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the notion of "reply usability" for LLM agents with an automatic reader-model-based metric, showing that over half of agent replies are unusable to requesters, and reduces the failure rate from 0.52 to 0.43 by having agents state explicit requirements for their replies.
